review_description: Kennedys was exceptionally professional, detailed and thorough, all the way through from initial contact to installation. I went back and forth a bit because of some changes to solar subsidies for batteries and the team was very patient throughout. I've very very happy with their service and won't hesitate to recommend them to others looking for their service.
I can recommend the team from Kennedy Solar they were very efficient and did a good job with the installation.
